name: common_logger
purpose: Provide a single shared project logger (CAD_System) and optional Excel test recording for checkpoints/critical sections.
public_api: CriticalSection(description='关键操作', script_name=None, func_name=None) (context manager)
side_effects: Writes rotating log file: cad/system/system_run.log (if file handler available).
May write Excel rows: cad/tests/testfunc.xlsx (only if openpyxl installed).
May pause/print only when MODE=1 and WHO='HUMAN' and WAIT>0.
constraints: Business modules should NOT call set_debug_mode(); call it once in entry/test/agent startup.
